newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian OTC market down, but new interest noted.
newsitem.headline: Romanian OTC market down, but new interest noted.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market slipped on Tuesday, but traders noted renewed moderate buying interest after a week of losses.
Operators said investors considered prices of some major companies had fallen sufficiently to start buying, and forecast a slightly upward path for forthcoming sessions.
Independent indices VAB-RA and BIG-OTC, computed by the VANGUARD and BIG brokerage houses, fell by 0.54 and 1.11 percent respectively to 3,549.34 and 2,614.61 points.
Traders said the slide of the indices was due to price slippage on smaller firms.

Cement maker Romcim closed 2,500 lei higher at 66,500, while Moldocim gained 500 lei and ended at 29,000. Another cement maker, Casial, was heavily traded throughout the day but finished flat at 1,500 lei.
Oil refinery Arpechim ended 1,000 lei firmer at 26,000 with some 58,000 shares traded.
Plane maker IAR tumbled 8,000 lei to close at 33,000, but traders said that only a few dozen shares were traded at this price. They said some deals were concluded at 41,000 lei.
Operators said thin volumes reflected a wait-and-see attitude from investors ahead of Wednesday's expected announcement that U.S. firm Bell Helicopter Textron would buy a large stake in IAR.
Turnover fell to 7.54 billion lei on Tuesday's session from 8.08 billion the previous day. Volume stood at 3.1 million shares, down from 3.5 million.
